// Command smokehost is the FUL-1651 phase-2 smoke harness. It maps the three
// documented cluster env vars onto the landed raft packages and runs the flow
// group, so the smoke observes the real discovery, bootstrap, eviction and
// recovery code paths rather than a reimplementation of them.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"strconv"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/hashicorp/go-hclog"
	"github.com/whitaker-io/machine/raft/ledger"
	"github.com/whitaker-io/machine/raft/membership"
	"github.com/whitaker-io/machine/raft/transport"
)

func main() {
	logger := hclog.New(&hclog.LoggerOptions{
		Name: "smokehost", Level: hclog.Debug, Output: os.Stdout,
	})

	node := os.Getenv("MACHINE_NODE_ID")
	advertise := os.Getenv("MACHINE_ADVERTISE")
	bind := os.Getenv("MACHINE_BIND")
	flow := os.Getenv("MACHINE_FLOW")
	peers := os.Getenv("MACHINE_CLUSTER_PEERS")
	secret := os.Getenv("MACHINE_CLUSTER_SECRET")
	// LEDGER_ID exists ONLY to drive the diverged-identity shape: when it is set
	// and differs from MACHINE_NODE_ID, the ledger reports one id and
	// membership.Config.Node carries another, which is the disagreement
	// ErrIdentityDiverged refuses.
	ledgerID := os.Getenv("MACHINE_LEDGER_ID")
	if ledgerID == "" {
		ledgerID = node
	}
	expect := 0
	if v := os.Getenv("MACHINE_CLUSTER_EXPECT"); v != "" {
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "smokehost: MACHINE_CLUSTER_EXPECT:", err)
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		expect = n
	}

	addr, err := net.ResolveTCPAddr("tcp", advertise)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "smokehost: advertise:", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	mux, err := transport.New(transport.Config{
		BindAddr:  bind,
		Advertise: addr,
		Logger:    logger.Named("mux"),
		Tokens:    []transport.Token{transport.Token(secret)},
	})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "smokehost: mux:", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	defer mux.Close()

	manager, err := membership.New(membership.Config{
		Node:      node,
		Advertise: advertise,
		Mux:       mux,
		Logger:    logger.Named("membership"),
		Flows:     []string{flow},
		Peers:     peers,
		Expect:    expect,
		Open: func(f string) (*ledger.Ledger, error) {
			return ledger.Open(ledger.Config{
				Flow: f, LocalID: ledgerID, Mux: mux, Logger: logger.Named("ledger"),
			})
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "smokehost: membership.New:", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}

	// THE PROMOTER CANNOT SEE A JOINER CATCH UP WITHOUT THIS. Every node answers
	// for itself over the control channel, and flowPilot.FetchServerStats reads
	// exactly this callback; a host that omits it leaves every staged nonvoter
	// permanently unpromoted, which reads as a promotion defect and is not one.
	//
	// MACHINE_DISABLE_LOCAL_STATS EXISTS ONLY TO DRIVE THAT SHAPE DELIBERATELY.
	// The smoke's fail-silent leg needs a fleet that omits the callback so it can
	// record what the promoter says, if anything, when its stats are absent.
	if os.Getenv("MACHINE_DISABLE_LOCAL_STATS") != "" {
		logger.Warn("SMOKEHOST-NO-LOCAL-STATS", "node", node,
			"note", "the local stats callback is deliberately not installed")
	} else {
		manager.SetLocalStats(func(f string) (membership.FlowStats, bool) {
			l, ok := manager.Ledger(f)
			if !ok {
				return membership.FlowStats{}, false
			}
			r := l.Raft()
			st := r.Stats()
			parse := func(k string) uint64 {
				n, _ := strconv.ParseUint(st[k], 10, 64)
				return n
			}
			lc := time.Duration(0)
			if d, err := time.ParseDuration(st["last_contact"]); err == nil {
				lc = d
			}
			return membership.FlowStats{
				Term:        parse("term"),
				LastIndex:   parse("last_log_index"),
				LastContact: lc,
				Voter:       st["state"] != "",
				Leader:      r.State() == 2,
			}, true
		})
	}

	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()

	if err := manager.Start(ctx); err != nil {
		// THE REFUSAL IS PRINTED VERBATIM AND THE PROCESS EXITS NON-ZERO. The
		// diverged-identity leg reads this line.
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "smokehost: start:", err)
		os.Exit(3)
	}
	defer manager.Close()

	logger.Info("SMOKEHOST-UP", "node", node, "flow", flow, "advertise", advertise, "expect", expect)

	tick := time.NewTicker(2 * time.Second)
	defer tick.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-tick.C:
			cfg, _, ok := manager.Membership(flow)
			if !ok {
				logger.Info("SMOKEHOST-STATE", "node", node, "flow", flow, "members", "none")
				continue
			}
			out := ""
			for _, s := range cfg.Servers {
				out += fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s ", s.ID, s.Suffrage)
			}
			logger.Info("SMOKEHOST-STATE", "node", node, "flow", flow, "members", out)
		}
	}
}
